content_of_post_to_answer: Can you completely heal from something that changed your personality?
answer: Complete healing may not mean returning to the person you were before. Some experiences alter your personality because they change your understanding of safety, trust, or yourself. The overlooked distinction is between being changed and being damaged. A healed person may still carry the lessons of what happened, but those lessons no longer control their choices. Sometimes recovery is not rebuilding the old self; it is learning to live freely with the new one.
